build_blocker_resolution.previous_diagnosis: Host cannot link the test target; 20 xcodebuild attempts stalled; must move to the self-hosted Mac mini.
build_blocker_resolution.actual_cause: The working copy lives in iCloud Drive (~/Documents) and fileproviderd was saturated (observed 84.8% CPU for 8h21m). The project uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup, so every xcodebuild invocation enumerates the whole tree through the file provider and stalls before spawning any compiler. Measured on the same host and same Xcode 26.2: `xcodebuild -list` timed out at 90s in place, and returned exit 0 in 1.1s from a local-disk copy.
build_blocker_resolution.workaround: rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude '.build*' --exclude 'artifacts' --exclude 'website' --exclude 'ci' ThumbnailMaker ThumbnailMakerTests ThumbnailMakerUITests ThumbnailMaker.xcodeproj <local-disk dir>/  then build there. The copy is 5.3 MB and takes under a second. The Mac mini is not required for local unit-test feedback; docs/CI_GATES.md gate evidence is unchanged.
build_blocker_resolution.note: git log also hangs in place for the same reason; git status / rev-parse / show -s HEAD work.
